intended_object: A helper map in the library's proof of Moise's triangulation theorem: it sends one closed face of the replacement triangle complex into the source space X by composing the face's inclusion into the complex's support with the inverse of the presentation homeomorphism X ≃ₜ support. Inferred from the docstring and the body.
explanation: The definition is just `Q.sourceHomeomorph.symm ∘ faceToSupport f`. It moves the parametrization of one face of the complex back to the source space through the bundled homeomorphism `sourceHomeomorph : X ≃ₜ complex.support`, which is a field of the structure `PolygonalReplacementPresentation` (line 1960 of the same file). Both that structure and this map are internal scaffolding for the chart-induction step of the proof. Neither has a standard counterpart in the literature or in Mathlib. As an auxiliary map the definition does what its docstring says: it reuses the same abstract face coordinates as `Q.complex.faceMap`, and the lemma right after it (`sourceHomeomorph_sourceFaceMap`, line 2050) checks that it is compatible with the homeomorphism. Since it is a proof device rather than a mathematical object, it is classified as not_a_mathematical_object.
